name: PP Daily Register
description: One event/site/day roster with explicit attendance and auditable approved wages.

fields.label: Work Date
fields.description: The attendance date. Each worker may total at most one full day across all sites on this date.

fields.label: Site
fields.description: The work location. Prepare the register from Work sites to fill its active worker allocations automatically.

fields.label: Worker Attendance
fields.description: Crew is filled from the event/site allocations. Mark Present, Absent or Half day, then approve the reviewed register to record wages.
